edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner during _init, letting an external caller become owner.
msg.sender writes its own _addressToActiveVersion entry.
mintAllow requires allowedAddress == msg.sender before minting.
mint uses msg.sender as the mint recipient and refund receiver.
buyToken treats msg.sender as the buyer of the token.
msg.sender is used as entropy in the pseudo-random generator.
sale price depends on block.timestamp, making pricing miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is used as randomness entropy in _random.
init externally calls the internal _init initializer.
lockTokenURI derives the reveal offset from _random.
mint computes the unit price through _currentPrice.
mint performs the actual token creation through _mintRandom.
mintAllow validates the recovered signer through _checkValidSigner.
mintAllow mints the purchased amount via _mintRandom.
mintAllow sends a refund transfer to the caller after minting, an external value call.
buyToken derives the required price from _currentPrice.
buyToken marks the sale hash as finalized via _markHashSold.
buyToken moves the token with the internal _transfer.
buyToken makes an external payable call to the payout contract for royalties.
buyToken transfers excess ETH back to the buyer with a raw transfer.
withdrawBalance forwards the balance via an external payable call to the payout contract.
_mintRandom delegates random index selection to _mintRandomIndex when revealed.
_mintRandom sequentially safe-mints tokens when not yet revealed.
_mintRandomIndex consumes pseudo-randomness from _random.
_mintRandomIndex safe-mints the selected index to the buyer.
_safeMint calls the internal _mint after receiver check.
_mint writes the new owner into the _owners mapping.
_burn decrements the owner's _balances entry.
_transfer adjusts _balances for both from and to addresses.
hashToSignForAllowList requires the caller to be a valid signer.
cancelAllowList requires the caller to be a valid signer.
cancelAllowList marks the order hash in _cancelledOrFinalizedSales.
cancelSale marks the caller's order hash as cancelled.
_markHashSold flags the order hash as finalized to prevent replay.
_markHashSold computes the signed hash through _hashToCheckForSale.
_hashToCheckForSale wraps the raw order hash from _hashForSale.
buyToken internally derives the order hash to verify the signature.
setAltSigner writes alternateSignerAddress under onlyOwner.
setRevenueShare updates the revenueShare address array.
setRevenueShare updates the revenueShareBPS array.
setRoyaltiesBPS updates ownerRoyaltyBPS under onlyOwner.
lockTokenURI stores the random reveal offset.
lockTokenURI sets the final ipfsHash.
lockTokenURI flips isRevealed to true.
lockTokenURI can reduce maxSupply to the current minted amount, locking remaining tokens.
lockTokenURI sets randOffset to the current total minted.
_init sets hasInit to block re-initialization.
_init sets maxSupply from untrusted configuration input.
_init sets transactionMax with a hard-coded cap of 20.
_init sets maxMint per wallet.
_init sets the burnable flag.
_init sets the initial reveal state.
_init stores the initial ipfsHash.
_init assigns the alternateSignerAddress from configuration.
_init sets ownerRoyaltyBPS via _setRoyaltiesBPS.
_init sets the revenueShare array.
_init sets the revenueShareBPS array.
_init writes _owner directly, bypassing Ownable constructors.
_mintRandom increments the buyer's mintCount against maxMint.
_mintRandom increments _totalMinted by the minted amount.
_mintRandomIndex reads and writes the indices swap array.
mint supply check reads _totalMinted before incrementing it.
buyToken verifies the seller's active signature version.
mintAllow verifies the owner's active presale signature version.
updateVersion writes a caller-controlled version value.
tokenURI branches on the isRevealed flag.
tokenURI applies the reveal offset to the tokenId.
tokenURI takes the offset modulo maxSupply.
_markHashSold recovers the order signer with ecrecover-based ECDSA.
mintAllow recovers the allow-list signer via ecrecover.
_random relies on weak block-variable pseudo-randomness.
buyAmount bounds checks flow into mintAllow supply and transaction limits.
amount parameter drives mint supply and transaction limits.
signature parameter is consumed by _markHashSold recovery.
tokenId parameter is consumed by the internal transfer.
pricesAndTimestamps array supplies the price and timestamp bounds.
currentPrice local flows into mint payment checks.
totalPrice local flows into mint payment checks.
hash local is produced by the sale hash builder.
supplyLeft local governs the random swap loop bounds.
index local is the random slot selected for minting.

normalization_plan.reason: buyAmount is only meaningful inside the mintAllow supply and limit checks.
amount exists only to drive mint price and supply validation.
signature is consumed solely by the ECDSA recovery in _markHashSold.
tokenId is the identifier consumed by the internal ownership transfer.
the array exclusively feeds the descending price computation.
currentPrice is a temporary value inside the mint payment logic.
totalPrice is a temporary value inside the mint payment logic.
hash is the derived order hash produced by the sale hash builder.
supplyLeft is a loop-local counter within random index minting.
index is a loop-local random slot within random index minting.
